const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function eeGet(obj) {
  return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => obj.evaluate(resolve, reject));
}

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const start = '2018-06-15';
    const endExclusive = '2018-06-23'; // to include 2018-06-22
    const scale = 5000; // ~5 km, appropriate for CHIRPS (0.05 deg)
    const mmPerInch = 25.4;

    const cities = [
      {
        name: 'Victoria, TX',
        geom: ee.Geometry.Point([-97.0036, 28.8053]).buffer(15000)
      },
      {
        name: 'Corpus Christi, TX',
        geom: ee.Geometry.Point([-97.3964, 27.8006]).buffer(15000)
      }
    ];

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check (primary: CHIRPS; fallback: GRIDMET)
    async function getCollection() {
      let collId = 'UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY';
      let band = 'precipitation';
      let col = ee.ImageCollection(collId).filterDate(start, endExclusive).select(band);
      let size = await eeGet(col.size());
      if (!size || size === 0) {
        // Fallback to GRIDMET
        collId = 'IDAHO_EPSCOR/GRIDMET';
        band = 'pr';
        col = ee.ImageCollection(collId).filterDate(start, endExclusive).select(band);
        size = await eeGet(col.size());
        return { col, size, collId, band };
      }
      return { col, size, collId, band };
    }

    const { col, size, collId, band } = await getCollection();
    if (!size || size === 0) {
      console.log(`Dataset: (none)`);
      console.log(`Date: 2018-06-15 to 2018-06-22 (inclusive), Images: 0`);
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Processing (sum precipitation over period)
    const sumImg = col.sum().rename('sum'); // mm over the period

    async function analyzeCity(city) {
      const countDict = await eeGet(sumImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: city.geom,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }));
      const count = countDict ? countDict.sum : null;

      const meanDict = await eeGet(sumImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: city.geom,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }));
      const mm = meanDict ? meanDict.sum : null;

      return { count, mm };
    }

    // Analyze both cities
    const results = [];
    for (const city of cities) {
      const res = await analyzeCity(city);
      results.push({ city: city.name, count: res.count, mm: res.mm });
    }

    // 4. Validation
    // Check counts and values
    if (results.some(r => r.count === 0 || r.count === null || r.count === undefined)) {
      console.log(`Dataset: ${collId} (band: ${band})`);
      console.log(`Date: 2018-06-15 to 2018-06-22 (inclusive), Images: ${size}`);
      for (const r of results) {
        console.log(`${r.city} (pixels: ${r.count || 0}): null mm (null in)`);
      }
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }
    if (results.some(r => r.mm === null || isNaN(r.mm) || !isFinite(r.mm) || r.mm < 0)) {
      console.log(`Dataset: ${collId} (band: ${band})`);
      console.log(`Date: 2018-06-15 to 2018-06-22 (inclusive), Images: ${size}`);
      for (const r of results) {
        const mmStr = (r.mm === null || !isFinite(r.mm)) ? 'null' : r.mm.toFixed(1);
        const inStr = (r.mm === null || !isFinite(r.mm)) ? 'null' : (r.mm / mmPerInch).toFixed(2);
        console.log(`${r.city} (pixels: ${r.count}): ${mmStr} mm (${inStr} in)`);
      }
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // 5. Output Evidence and Final Answer
    console.log(`Dataset: ${collId} (band: ${band})`);
    console.log(`Date: 2018-06-15 to 2018-06-22 (inclusive), Images: ${size}`);
    for (const r of results) {
      const inches = r.mm / mmPerInch;
      console.log(`${r.city} (pixels: ${r.count}): ${r.mm.toFixed(1)} mm (${inches.toFixed(2)} in)`);
    }

    const bothUnder20 = results.every(r => (r.mm / mmPerInch) < 20.0);
    console.log(bothUnder20 ? 'A' : 'B');
  } catch (err) {
    // In case of API or method errors
    console.log(`Error: ${err && err.message ? err.message : err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
